items.title: Robinhood CEO Responds to AMC Tokenization Criticism
items.summary: Robinhood Chief Executive Vlad Tenev defended the company's push into tokenized stocks in a CNBC interview Wednesday.  Tenev's remarks come on the heels of fiery criticism from AMC Chief Executive Adam Aron, whose company's shares are among those being tokenized.  Tenev said companies can't control the financial products created around their shares once public.
